name: Default
shortDescription: Live TV channel builder that turns Plex, Jellyfin or Emby libraries into an IPTV playlist, XMLTV guide and emulated HDHomeRun tuner.

alerts.message: The web UI asks for HTTP Basic Auth: sign in as admin with the generated TUNARR_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD from the environment settings. A Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server reachable from this host is needed to add programming.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
